== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 29 August 2013. The Facebook photo viewer names Bill Zalman. Identification: distinctive name plus Red 8 on the Decipher Squadron roster (Garland, Tx). The Facebook profile is facebook.com/bill.zalman (Lives in Dallas, Texas).
Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Bill Zalman portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Bill Zalman Facebook portrait.jpg]].
